text:
Hyundai Motor said Friday it has unveiled its eighth-generation Avante compact sedan, known as the Elantra in North America, and the Genesis G80 Hybrid at the Los Angeles Auto Show.
The Korean automaker showcased the all-new 2027 Elantra and 2028 Elantra Hybrid during a media preview of the auto show at the Los Angeles Convention Center in California.
The all-new Elantra will be available with two powertrain options: a 2.0-liter gasoline engine and a 1.6-liter hybrid powertrain.
Genesis, Hyundai Motor's luxury brand, also unveiled the G80 Hybrid with enhanced power output and fuel efficiency.
The G80 Hybrid combines a 2.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine with a dual-motor hybrid system, offering a driving range of approximately 1,029 kilometers on a single tank of fuel.
The model also features a liquid-cooled battery system for improved thermal efficiency and higher discharge power compared with air-cooled systems.
